name: Exp_wajdyss_Ichimoku_Candle_MMRec
summary: This EA trades based on Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator signals combined with candlestick pattern recognition. It uses money management recommendations (MMRec) to dynamically adjust position sizes. Entries are triggered when price action and Ichimoku cloud alignment confirm a trend direction.
summary_zh: 该EA基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku)指标信号与K线形态识别相结合进行交易。它使用资金管理建议(MMRec)来动态调整仓位大小。当价格行为和一目均衡表云图对齐确认趋势方向时触发入场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于一目均衡表(Ichimoku Kinko Hyo)指标，结合K线形态进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件包括：价格突破云图（Kumo）、转换线（Tenkan-sen）与基准线（Kijun-sen）的金叉/死叉、以及K线形态确认方向。多头入场要求价格在云图上方且转换线上穿基准线，同时K线收阳确认；空头反之。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号、价格跌破云图支撑或触及止损/止盈。仓位管理采用MMRec模块，根据账户余额和风险比例动态计算手数，支持固定手数和百分比风险两种模式。资金管理方面，EA内置了止损计算逻辑，根据ATR或固定点数设置止损，并结合风险百分比确定每笔交易的风险金额。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator combined with candlestick pattern recognition for trend-following trading. Entry conditions include: price breaking through the Kumo (cloud), Tenkan-sen/Kijun-sen crossovers (golden cross/death cross), and candlestick pattern confirmation of direction. Long entry requires price above the cloud with Tenkan-sen crossing above Kijun-sen, confirmed by a bullish candle close; short entry is the reverse. Exit conditions include: reverse crossover signals, price breaking below cloud support, or hitting stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing uses the MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) module, which dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance and risk percentage, supporting both fixed lot and percentage-based risk modes. Money management incorporates stop-loss calculation logic using either ATR-based or fixed-pipstop distances, combined with risk percentage to determine the risk amount per trade.

pros: 一目均衡表是多维度趋势指标，同时提供支撑阻力、趋势方向和动量信息，策略逻辑完整
MMRec资金管理模块根据账户风险动态调整仓位，有利于长期稳定增长和风险控制
结合K线形态确认入场信号，减少了假突破导致的亏损交易
Ichimoku参数可调，适应不同品种和周期，灵活性较好
pros_en: Ichimoku is a multi-dimensional trend indicator providing support/resistance, trend direction, and momentum simultaneously, making the strategy logic comprehensive
The MMRec money management module dynamically adjusts position size based on account risk, supporting long-term stable growth and risk control
Candlestick pattern confirmation for entries reduces false breakout losses
Adjustable Ichimoku parameters allow adaptation to different instruments and timeframes, offering good flexibility
cons: 一目均衡表在震荡行情中频繁发出假信号，容易导致连续亏损
缺乏市场波动率过滤机制（如ATR阈值），在低波动率环境下可能频繁开仓
未检测是否存在加仓或马丁格尔逻辑的隐藏风险，若MMRec模块计算不当可能过度放大仓位
止损设置若依赖固定点数而非ATR，在不同波动率品种上适配性差
cons_en: Ichimoku frequently generates false signals in ranging markets, potentially leading to consecutive losses
Lacks volatility filtering mechanism (e.g., ATR threshold), may open positions frequently in low-volatility environments
Hidden risk of position scaling or martingale logic if MMRec module calculations are improper, potentially over-leveraging positions
If stop-loss relies on fixed pips rather than ATR, adaptability across instruments with different volatility profiles is poor
improvements: 增加震荡/趋势市场识别过滤器（如ADX），在震荡行情中暂停交易或减少仓位
增加多时间框架确认机制，要求高一级时间框架趋势方向一致才允许入场
建议使用ATR动态止损替代固定点数止损，以适应不同品种的波动特性
improvements_en: Add a ranging/trending market identification filter (e.g., ADX) to pause trading or reduce position size in ranging markets
Add multi-timeframe confirmation requiring higher-timeframe trend alignment before entry is allowed
Recommend using ATR-based dynamic stop-loss instead of fixed-pip stops to adapt to different instruments' volatility characteristics

risk_points: 一目均衡表在震荡市中假信号多，可能导致频繁止损
若MMRec模块风险百分比设置过高，单笔亏损可能超出承受范围
未明确是否有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Ichimoku generates many false signals in ranging markets, potentially causing frequent stop-outs
If MMRec module risk percentage is set too high, single-trade loss may exceed tolerable limits
Unclear whether new bar check mechanism exists, risk of repeated entries on the same bar

It uses money management recommendations (MMRec) to dynamically adjust position sizes. Entries are triggered when price action and Ichimoku cloud alignment confirm a trend direction.
